title: Adobe reports Q3 FY2026 earnings after the bell with analysts watching AI ARR and guidance
summary: Adobe releases its third quarter fiscal year 2026 results after market close on Thursday, September 10, followed by a 2:00-3:00 p.m. Pacific conference call streamed on its Investor Relations site. Prior guidance calls for quarterly revenue of $6.67 billion to $6.72 billion, with analysts focused on Creative Cloud and Document Cloud AI ARR growth and any commentary on Firefly's competitive position against Anthropic and OpenAI's expanding enterprise offerings.
